from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial record extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code of the company if available")
    contract_liabilities_amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported balance of Contract Liabilities at the end of the reporting period (in Yuan)")
    report_period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period, format YYYY-MM-DD")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate of records extracted from the document(s)."""
    company_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
